scientific_findings: CONTRASTIVE_PROTOTYPE_LIMITATION: While CDMR-Net achieves strong utility (0.4680) and low ECE (0.0166), explicit prototype clustering forces non-native phonetic variants into artificial clusters, slightly degrading substitution precision relative to unconstrained continuous local attention (HRTD-Net EXP-48).

HRTD_NET_REMAINS_CHAMPION: High-Resolution Temporal Dynamics (5ms sub-frame windowing) without discrete prototype clustering remains the laboratory champion with Macro AP=0.6202, Macro F1=0.6050, and Utility=0.4846.
